_doc: Registry of every repository in the cloud project. clone.sh reads this and nothing else — adding a repo here is the only edit needed for it to show up in `./clone.sh --list`, be clonable, and get a symlink. Deliberately NOT submodules: a submodule pins a commit, and this is an index of working clones, not a pinned build input.
base_dir_doc: Where clones live. Override with $CLOUD_GIT_BASE; otherwise ~/git. Clones are NEVER placed inside this repo — cloud-master holds symlinks pointing out to them, so a repo you have cloned appears here and one you have not simply does not.
